column1: # Source-owned test evidence for independently translated ADMIN parser leaves.

column8: The bare ADMIN SHOW DDL row at line 491 restores exactly as its own unit leaf and rejects a trailing token. The three direct ADMIN SHOW DDL JOBS accepted rows at lines 492-494 restore exactly with typed number/WHERE payloads; line 495 negative job number is rejected. The six ADMIN SHOW DDL JOB QUERIES rows at lines 496-501 preserve list and LIMIT offset/count alternatives with canonical restoration. The CANCEL/PAUSE/RESUME DDL job-control rows at lines 508-517 retain Go's discarded JOB/JOBS/FOO noun behavior and typed signed ID list. The ADMIN ALTER DDL JOBS option rows at lines 546-553 preserve ordered lower-cased names, SignedLiteral values, and canonical string restoration in rust/crates/tidb-parser/src/tests/admin_alter_ddl_jobs_source.rs.
